checks.name: KOSPI 200 추종 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(cu_base_index, ref_base_index) ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%')

checks.name: S&P500 추종 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(cu_base_index, ref_base_index) ILIKE '%S&P%500%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%S&P%500%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%S&P%500%') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 나스닥100 추종 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(cu_base_index, ref_base_index) ILIKE '%나스닥%100%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%나스닥%100%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%나스닥%100%') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 키움 ETF 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '키움%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, e.pd_itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 신한 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) = '신한'

checks.name: 미래에셋 ETF 분배수익률 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '미래에셋%' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(e.pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) DESC, e.pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 미래에셋 ETF 1년 수익률 상위 5
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '미래에셋%' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(e.du_er_1y AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.du_er_1y AS DOUBLE) DESC, e.pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 삼성 ETF 괴리율 1위
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE e.drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) = '삼성' OR coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '삼성%') AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(e.du_diff_rt AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.du_diff_rt AS DOUBLE) DESC, e.pd_itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: KODEX 반도체 구성종목 행 수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM etf_constituent WHERE etf_isin='KR7091160002'

checks.name: 해외 레버리지 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE abs(TRY_CAST(cu_lev_fector AS DOUBLE)) > 1 AND drv_instrument_type='ETF'

checks.name: MMF 공모펀드 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE or_attr_desc ILIKE '%MMF%'

checks.name: 혼합 운용속성 판매중 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE or_attr_desc ILIKE '%혼합%' AND replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중'

checks.name: 미래에셋 위험등급 1등급 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE (itm_nm ILIKE '%미래에셋%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%미래에셋%') AND TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT)=1

checks.name: TDF 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE itm_nm ILIKE '%TDF%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%TDF%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 금 관련 상장중 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%골드%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%금현물%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%금액티브%') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 ETF(비중 순)
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c LEFT JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, c.etf_isin LIMIT 30
